items.title: Full-stack observational Fishtank showcase, proximity-radius fix + safe spawn (fix of V3-EXQ-906a)
items.note: Bug-fix lettered iteration of V3-EXQ-906a (2026-08-09), routed by the user-confirmed failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-906a_894b_2026-08-09.md (Target 1). GOV-REUSE-1: no prior manifest carries a fixed-proximity-radius readout for this combined-flag config -- not recoverable, run. ROOT CAUSE: 906a fixed 2 of 3 independent health-drain channels (contamination_spread, hazard_harm) but left a third untouched -- proximity-approach damage (causal_grid_world.py ~2445-2469), which drains health on any step the agent is merely near a hazard's field, no contact required. 906a's scored run: 8/8 segments ended health_depleted, mean realized segment length 25.375 steps vs the ecology_survivable threshold 59.6, with only 1 external_hazard event recorded -- consistent with ambient proximity drain, not contact, matching the user's direct fishtank_viz observation (health draining fast with no hazard hit). FIX (parameters chosen by empirical Monte-Carlo grid-search over the field formula, NOT hand arithmetic -- see module docstring points 1-2 for the full correction story): a first draft used single-hazard-radius arithmetic (proximity_approach_threshold=0.6 at the untouched hazard_field_decay=0.5) and was DISPROVED by this driver's own smoke test (_safe_reset's 20-attempt bound exhausted on both dry-run segments) -- _compute_proximity_fields() SUMS all 4 hazards' field contributions, not max, so single-hazard arithmetic under-states the true ambient background and the first draft was still ~99% grid-wide unsafe. Re-derived empirically instead: simulated 400-500 random 4-hazard layouts on the 12x12 eval grid per (decay, threshold) pair, measured P(field>=threshold | nearest-hazard Manhattan distance). Shipped: hazard_field_decay 0.5->2.5, proximity_approach_threshold 0.15->0.4 (measured P(unsafe|d=1)=0.969, P(unsafe|d=2)=0.265, P(unsafe|d>=3)~0.006, mean unsafe grid fraction ~0.19), proximity_harm_scale 0.05->0.02 (further per-step drain gentling). This puts harm onset inside the agent's fixed radius-2 (5x5) sensory window with a genuine probabilistic 'smell before harm' gap at the window's own edge -- the substrate's additive (not max) field means the radius is not perfectly sharp/config-independent, stated as a caveat in the docstring rather than smoothed over. proximity_approach_threshold is a SHARED field also gating the resource-approach benefit bonus -- both cues become close-range together, deliberately, not a hidden side effect. SAFE SPAWN: added a bounded (20-attempt) env.reset() retry per segment so no segment starts already inside the harm zone (mirrors causal_grid_world.py's own microhabitat redraw-guard pattern); smoke-verified this specifically -- spawn_attempts dropped from 20/20 (both segments exhausted, first-draft parameters) to 1/1 (both segments, final parameters). LAYOUT: num_hazards/num_resources/size deliberately left unchanged (matches what the curriculum trained on) -- the radius fix alone was empirically verified (same grid-search) to leave ~81% of the grid safe on average, vs 906a's ~100% unsafe. RECORDING-CORE BUGS FIXED (906a's manifest was missing all three): elapsed_seconds never measured (now captured via time.perf_counter() -- time.time() was tried first and produced a nonsense negative elapsed_seconds, caught by reading the smoke manifest before trusting it); result['config'] never set (write_flat_manifest's config= kwarg silently got None); seeds hardcoded to None regardless of --seeds. All three confirmed fixed via validate_recording.py --strict on the dry-run manifest (0 always-core gaps). EPISODE-LOG DELIVERY -- OPS ACTION ITEM, NOT FIXED BY THIS SCRIPT: 906a's promised episode_log was never written to disk claim was only half right -- the driver DOES write it correctly every run; it never reached origin because Phase 3's companion-file transport (PHASE3_SPOOL_SIDEFILES, coordinator/sync_daemon.py) defaults OFF and is only a .example template in coordinator/deploy/shadow.conf.{hub,worker}.example in this repo. Cannot be confirmed or fixed from a driver script or this worktree -- OPERATOR: verify PHASE3_SPOOL_SIDEFILES=1 is set on both ree-sync-daemon (hub) and ree-cloud-4 (this entry's pinned worker) before assuming this run's episode_log will land on origin/master (see coordinator/OPERATOR_GUIDE.md 'Side-file sync'); if not set, this run repeats the identical gap regardless of the driver-side companion_files declaration also added here. NOT ACTED ON HERE (by design): the autopsy's secondary finding (SD-RESIDUE-VALENCE-BOUND, an unclamped RBFLayer.update_valence() accumulator in ree_core/residue/field.py) is pending /governance ratification per the autopsy-chip exception -- not this script's job. machine_affinity/estimated_minutes/episodes_per_run mirror 906a's own entry unchanged (identical curriculum + eval budgets, same substrate family, same worker).

items.title: MECH-357 freeze-incompatible Stage-H: mobile predators reintroduce the Pavlovian-instrumental conflict; 3-arm two-sided headroom guard (successor of 603r)
items.note: Freeze-incompatible successor of V3-EXQ-603r per failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-603r_2026-08-09. 603r's combined-fix rerun FAILED discrimination because the harm-pathway fix alone made passive PAG freeze/release survival-adequate in the STATIC Stage-H field, eliminating the Pavlovian-instrumental conflict Moscarello & LeDoux's active-avoidance paradigm needs (reclassified measurement_test_design_defect / non_contributory; NOT a MECH-357 weakens). 603s adds the autopsy-recommended freeze-incompatible pressure via MOBILE PREDATORS: exposes new scaffold knobs scaffold_hazard_stage_env_drift_interval/_prob (defaults 5/0.3 == env defaults, bit-identical for all prior consumers) and sets interval=1/prob=0.6 so fast-drifting hazards sweep the non-reef grid -- an undirected freeze/release policy is overrun in place while a directed escape-to-reef policy survives (reef stays a hazard-exclusion refuge under drift; verified 0 violations this session). Env-mechanics audit ruled OUT starvation (no energy->health death) and agent-directed pursuit (not in env; would be /implement-substrate) as config-buildable, leaving mobile-predators as the buildable freeze-incompatible lever. 3 arms x 3 seeds [42,43,44] with a TWO-SIDED discriminative-headroom guard (the check the 603h-floor/603r-ceiling history showed no existing flag tests): ARM_LESION (negative control) must now FAIL the gate (headroom below); ARM_POSCTRL (gated + reef spawn, positive control) must CLEAR it (survivability above). Mis-calibrated mobility self-routes to pressure_insufficient_requeue (LESION ceilinged) or pressure_impossible_requeue (POSCTRL floored), NOT a false verdict. GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout (G_H_LESION + INTACT-beats-LESION under a MOBILE-PREDATOR field) is a NEW manipulation absent from every recorded run (603r/603h ran env_drift 5/0.3) -> not reanalysis-recoverable, ran fresh. Re-derive brake: does NOT fire (0 prior substrate_ceiling autopsies tag MECH-357; 603r is measurement_test_design_defect/non_contributory). Substrate-overlap gate: no open corrupting substrate_queue entry overlaps scaffolded_sd054_onboarding.py or causal_grid_world.py. Also re-instruments MECH-357's avoidance_efficacy credit event per-episode (avoidance_efficacy_trajectory), still 'essentially inert' since 603h. Smoke PASS; full contract suite run on cloud. Prefer cloud (linux-x86_64).

items.title: MECH-075 ventral VTA-RPE probe -- instrumented re-run (903a): per-seed episode-length/termination recording + 5 seeds
items.note: Instrumented re-run of V3-EXQ-903 per failure_autopsy_mech075-vta-lc-cluster_2026-08-09 (ventral/VTA-RPE leg). 903 self-routed substrate_not_ready_requeue, confirmed correct: P0 readiness passed in only 1/3 seeds (seed 7), the seed-majority gate (n_p0a_pass=1) correctly FAILED despite the top-level seed-mean preconditions[].met reading true. THE CONFOUND: seed 7's apparent pass coincided with ~25x fewer eval samples (n_dt_samples 292 vs 6774-7956), consistent with near-immediate episode termination -- but 903 recorded no episode-length/termination-cause, so the confound could only be inferred. 903a records per-seed/per-condition/positive-control episode LENGTH + TERMINATION CAUSE (info[done_cause]: health_depleted vs step_budget_exhausted; condition_stats[*].mean_episode_length/.termination_causes, seed_records[*].posctrl_episode_stats, .n_posctrl_valence_samples), so a future P0 read is trustable against the actual per-seed sampling regime. Also raises seed count 3->5 (majority 2/3->3/5) and POSCTRL 5->10 to cut small-sample P0a correlation volatility. Mechanism/signal/terrain/phased-training/criteria UNCHANGED. GOV-REUSE-1: the per-seed episode-length/termination readout is absent from 903's manifest and not derivable by reanalysis (903 ran at the old instrumentation) -> genuine new run. Re-derive brake does NOT fire (autopsy re_derive_brake.fired=false; zero prior substrate_ceiling autopsies for MECH-075). Prefer cloud (903 ran on ree-cloud-4, ~175 min for 3 seeds).

items.title: SD-020 real flag-path retest: harm_surprise_pe OFF vs ON via agent.compute_harm_accum_loss (SD-022 substrate)
items.note: Governance-commissioned (2026-08-09 GFLAG-0005) real flag-path retest of SD-020, demoted stable->candidate because the promoting run 324b was a STANDALONE BENCH (zero REEAgent/harm_surprise_pe_enabled/compute_harm_accum_loss refs) and even 324 reimplements the PE target manually against a standalone head. (Note: queue_id 324c was already burned by an empty April-2026 completion with no manifest; this is 324d.) This run trains z_harm_a through the SHIPPED loss agent.compute_harm_accum_loss(accum, latent) under harm_surprise_pe_enabled, via the proven affective_fishtank.warmup_train harness. PE-branch differentiation gate (ARM_OFF _harm_obs_ema==0, ARM_ON>1e-4) PROVES the shipped branch fired -- confirmed in design probes (OFF 0.0, ON 0.0187 at 20ep). SUBSTRATE SD-022 (limb_damage_enabled=True) re-sources harm_obs_a from 7-dim damage state, fixing 324's harm_obs_a_variance~3e-4 + underpowering (probes: 367/400 harm events vs 324's 10-20). Primary DV: harm_accum_pred surprise-vs-magnitude preference (head readout, not saturation-masked z_harm_a norm); PASS=ARM_ON shifts toward surprise in >=3/5 seeds. NON-DEGENERACY self-routes non_contributory (NOT weakens) if the flag path didn't differentiate, run is underpowered, DV unmeasurable, or the manipulation produced no measurable representational change -- design probes show a SMALL OFF-vs-ON delta (~0.02 at 20ep), so a non_contributory outcome is a plausible, honest result that keeps SD-020 at candidate rather than a false verdict. DV-SYMMETRY: the manipulation changes z_harm_a's learned weights, and corr(head, PE/accum) is not invariant under any broadcast/rescale/permutation of the latent -- a nonzero ON-vs-OFF delta is a real measurement. GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout (surprise-vs-magnitude preference under the REAL flag path) is recorded in NO manifest -- 324/324a/324b are benches, 856 drives the real path but on a different DV (CoV+mode inversion) and non-limb_damage substrate -> run. 2.5c: only open substrate_paths overlap is mech203-valence-pool-admissibility (update_harm_salience/HarmEncoder), unset severity + different code path than compute_harm_accum_loss/z_harm_a -> no gating. Directly addresses Q-036. Prefer cloud (linux-x86_64 machine-class) for reproducibility.
